info.title: Smart Subtitle Converter API
info.description: Convert subtitles between text and binary broadcast formats (EBU STL, PAC, Cavena 890, ...) with Subtitle Edit's libse. Errors are RFC 7807 problem+json with a stable `code`, a `hint` and the `requestId`. Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>` when API keys are configured.

get.summary: Re-read the job's stored input location; never a cached file.
get.description: Any valid API key knowing the id may fetch it. Current allowlists, hidden-path rule, extension allowlist and size limits apply: a file or S3 location whose extension is not a subtitle format (GET /v1/limits storage.extensions) is 422 extension-not-allowed, also for failed jobs. Query-redacted HTTPS locations cannot be replayed. Files may have changed or disappeared. Shares the browse queue (503 browse-busy). File and S3 files carry an ETag; If-None-Match with it gives 304 Not Modified without reading the content.

By default lists every convertible format, text and binary. `textOnly=true` keeps text formats only. `kind` is a comma list of text|binary|image|container and wins over `textOnly`; image/container formats are listed only via `kind` and can't be converted. `writable=true` keeps formats that can be a target.

get.summary: List the allowed storage locations (file roots, S3 buckets and prefixes, HTTPS hosts).
get.description: The existing allowlists, as folders to pass to GET /v1/storage/list. HTTPS hosts are reported as not listable and not readable by location (convert input/output only). Never includes credentials or query strings. On by default; with STORAGE_LIST_ENABLED=false it is 403 storage-list-disabled.

get.summary: List one folder of an allowed file or S3 location, a page at a time.
get.description: `location` is a folder (file:///root/folder/, /root/folder/ or s3://bucket/prefix/), `prefix` an optional name prefix ('/' descends into sub-folders; no globs). Lists one level in backend name order (UTF-8 byte order), at most 200 items per page: files with a subtitle extension (GET /v1/limits storage.extensions) with size and modified time, and folders (ending in '/'). When `truncated` is true pass `next` as `cursor` with the same location and prefix. Stateless: items that exist for the whole walk appear exactly once; items created or deleted during the walk may or may not appear. No total count, time sort or offsets. A filesystem folder with more than 5000 matching entries is 422 folder-too-large (narrow it with `prefix`). Hidden entries (names starting with '.') are skipped; a hidden folder or a prefix starting with '.' is 422 hidden-path. Filesystem listings also skip symlinks and special files. HTTPS is not listable (422 storage-not-listable). Shares the browse queue with reads by location and job file reads (503 browse-busy with Retry-After when it is full). On by default; with STORAGE_LIST_ENABLED=false it is 403 storage-list-disabled.

get.summary: Read one file from an allowed file or S3 location (current contents, unconverted).
get.description: The same allowlists, symlink, traversal, hidden-file, extension and size checks as convert input: outside the allowed locations is 422 storage-location-rejected, a path or key with a component starting with '.' is 422 hidden-path, a name without a subtitle extension is 422 extension-not-allowed. HTTPS is not readable here (422 storage-not-listable); use it as convert input. Shares the browse queue (503 browse-busy). The response carries an ETag (file: size, modification time and inode; S3: the object ETag); send it back as If-None-Match to get 304 Not Modified without the content being read (a cheap change check). On by default; with STORAGE_LIST_ENABLED=false it is 403 storage-list-disabled.

type.description: URL of the code's section in docs/errors.md.

debug.description: Diagnostics, only when ERRORS_VERBOSE=true. Never contains file content.

phase.description: conversion-timeout only: queue is retryable like 503.

items.description: string (format id / PAC code page) or {encoding, language, hits, sample} for text-encoding.

candidates.description: ambiguous-format: format ids (strings). ambiguous-encoding pac-code-page: code page names (strings). ambiguous-encoding text-encoding: objects {encoding, language, hits, sample}; set encoding.input or encoding.language, picking only from this list.

probe.description: ambiguous-encoding only: which probe could not decide.

ApiProblem.description: RFC 7807 problem details with a stable `code` (docs/errors.md). Extra members may appear: `phase` (conversion-timeout: queue|running), `candidates` (ambiguous-format, ambiguous-encoding), `probe` (ambiguous-encoding: pac-code-page|text-encoding).

ifExists.description: Default error: exclusive filesystem create or conditional S3 PUT. replace explicitly permits replacement. HTTPS follows signer/receiver policy.

FieldError.description: A problem located by a JSON pointer (profile field, query parameter, ...).

bearer.description: API key as a bearer token. Required only when the server has API_KEYS/API_KEYS_FILE set (GET /v1/limits → auth.required).
